The real estate agent is selling two homes right now: one that was owned by a Pakistani family, and one that was owned by a Yemeni family. The agents needs to have both houses cleaned, but the Yemeni family's house needs more cleaning because it smells of food, while the Pakistani family home will be a breeze to sell. Which home is hard to sell because it smells?
A. Unknown
B. The Yemeni family's home
C. The Pakistani family's home
